newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Property firm Nam Fong to list shares -- sources.
newsitem.headline: Property firm Nam Fong to list shares -- sources.

text.p: Nam Fong International Holdings Ltd, a Hong Kong-incorporated China property development group, is expected to list its shares on the Hong Kong stock market by the end of 1996, market sources said on Tuesday.
The China-backed Nam Fong engages in residential and commercial property developments in China's southern province of Guangdong, mainly in Guangzhou, the market sources said.
A Nam Fong spokesman declined to comment.
The sources said Nam Fong is expected to arrange a site visit for analysts on Friday before it kicks off a series of promotional activities for the listing, including road shows.
